classification.difficultyReason: Reconstruct whole quantities from fractional parts and apply the same unitary reasoning to elapsed time.

content.prompt: Use the unitary method in reverse to solve these problems.

children.label: a
children.prompt: If $\frac{3}{5}$ of a container used for storing milk is 150 litres, what is the capacity of the container?

answer.worked:
3 parts hold 150 litres.

$$\begin{align*}1\text{ part}&=150\div3=50\text{ litres}\\5\text{ parts}&=50\times5=250\text{ litres}\end{align*}$$

The capacity is 250 litres.

children.label: b
children.prompt: Massima has saved $\$495$, which is $\frac{11}{12}$ of the cost of a stereo. What is the price of the stereo?

answer.worked:
11 parts cost $\$495$.

$$\begin{align*}1\text{ part}&=\$495\div11=\$45\\12\text{ parts}&=\$45\times12=\$540\end{align*}$$

The stereo costs $\$540$.

children.label: c
children.prompt: Jehan saves $\$105$ every week, which is $\frac{3}{5}$ of his weekly wage. What is his weekly wage?

answer.worked:
3 parts of the weekly wage are $\$105$.

$$\begin{align*}1\text{ part}&=\$105\div3=\$35\\5\text{ parts}&=\$35\times5=\$175\end{align*}$$

Jehan's weekly wage is $\$175$.

children.label: d
children.prompt: Conrad is recovering from an operation and has been told to walk 10 000 steps per day. In 45 minutes, he has walked 3000 steps. If he walks at the same rate, how long will it take him to walk the required number of steps?

answer.worked:
3000 steps take 45 minutes.

$$\begin{align*}\text{Time for 1000 steps}&=45\div3=15\text{ minutes}\\\text{Time for 10 000 steps}&=15\times10=150\text{ minutes}\\\text{Time in hours}&=150\div60=2\frac{1}{2}\text{ hours}\end{align*}$$

The total time is 150 minutes, or $2\frac{1}{2}$ hours.
